task.title: Task form: one dependency field with a Depends On / Blocks toggle
task.description: Replace the two dependency sections in the task form sidebar (Depends On, Blocks) with one field: a single task picker, a toggle choosing Depends On or Blocks for the entry being added, and one list in which each row is clearly tagged Depends On or Blocks. Applies to both the New Task form and a task's page. Goal: reclaim vertical space in the sidebar and make entry faster for a person. No change to how dependencies are stored.
